subject: NAVIGATIONAL WARNING TO ALL CONCERNED:
text:
A1243/26 NOTAMN
Q) LTXX/QAFXX/IV/NBO/E /000/999/3822N02559E357
A) LTBB LGGG B) 2604011139 C) 2612311600
E) NAVIGATIONAL WARNING TO ALL CONCERNED:

REF (A) TURKISH WARNING NOTAMS A5935/25, A5936/25, A5937/25
REF (B) GREEK WARNING NOTAMS   A4490/25, A4491/25, A4492/25 AND 
A0951/26

THE VIEWS EXPRESSED IN TURKISH NAVIGATIONAL WARNING NOTAMS IN     
REF (A) WITH RESPECT TO TURKISH FIRING EXERCISE WITHIN INTERNATIONAL 
WATERS AND AIRSPACE REMAIN UNCHANGED AND THE NAVIGATIONAL WARNING 
NOTAMS IN REF(A) IS VALID AND EFFECTIVE. 
THE GREEK NAVIGATIONAL WARNING NOTAMS IN REF (B) IS NULL AND VOID.

TURKIYE ALSO WOULD LIKE TO EMPHASIZE THAT NO FURTHER EXPLANATION 
WILL BE GIVEN TO ANY OBJECTION RAISED TO TURKISH NOTAM IN REF (A).
